label: Tools
governingContracts: docs/plans/assets/tg-miniapp-mission-control-reference/frozen/05-copy-budget.md §4 (BANNED: copy-paste command blocks must not survive the redesign; actions POST via the gate client in-app)

envelopes.name: quest-envelope.commands
envelopes.authority: Worker-normalized quest envelope; legacy command data is accepted only at the server boundary and served as the typed projection
envelopes.consumedFor: live sheets (status/services/agents/activeWork/handoffs), availability states, recommendation card

envelopes.name: quest-envelope.openItems + branchStories
envelopes.authority: Worker KV gate store + operator packet build
envelopes.consumedFor: mission context strip, exact selected WorkObject identity and kind, recommendation derivation, handoff availability

dataFields.fallback: all live surfaces render stale and offer refresh

dataFields.type: ToolsCommandPanelProjection<'active-work', array<{id, status, title, who | owner, source}>>
ToolsCommandPanelProjection<'handoffs', array<{id, status, title, source, gateRelation}>>

dataFields.fallback: handoffs render locked when no waiting founder decision is served
context strip shows 'branch pending' / 'Branch packets pending'; recommendation panel EMPTY
Tools renders work pending, demotes the complete branch/mission context to pending, and exposes neither a partial identity nor a recommendation
blocked mission fallback drives ts-run to proof-needed: 'use Gate or Open Proof before acting'
digest commands (ts-standup/ts-digest) render active instead of proof-needed

dataFields.type: per-panel {state, checkedAt, source} plus strict aggregate
dataFields.source: typed command panel and global quest envelope
dataFields.fallback: a stale/unknown panel or stale envelope demotes its card and the aggregate Tools token, suppresses any recommendation targeting that panel, and exposes Retry in the stale sheet; unsafe source text renders source unavailable

aliases.proof-needed: 'needs proof' availability label on act/digest commands

derivation.active: panel declaration, checked-at timestamp, and global envelope are all fresh and coherent
derivation.stale: commands missing, global envelope stale, or panel stale/unknown/incoherent — affected surfaces are read-only
derivation.locked: ts-approve/ts-reject with zero open gate items

loading.render: 'Synchronizing toolbelt / Please wait…' + linear progress bar

empty.render: dashed circle + ops glyph; 'No mission recommendation yet — tools suggest after branch packets reach Mission' + Open Mission (outline)
empty.trigger: no branch packets and no recommendation derivable

error.render: peach triangle; stale result copy + Retry outline button; no command results or recommendations synthesized
error.trigger: commands envelope missing or the opened panel is stale/unknown/incoherent

redesignNote: frozen/05 §4 bans copy-paste command blocks and 'Copy command text' buttons in the redesign; P2 builders replace copy affordances with in-app actions or read-only sheets. This contract lists current-consumed fields so the replacement keeps data parity.
